_comment: What an avatar (version 2) is made of. Read by the client (client/src/lib/game/skins.js) AND by the server (src/services/avatarConfig.js) so both agree on what is valid. `looks` are the playable characters, i.e. the sheets built by scripts/build-game-skins.js (which rewrites this list; the characters themselves are described in gameCharacters.json, and a retired legacy look is converted to the character that replaced it); every colour part counts its options INCLUDING index 0 = 'as drawn' (no recolouring). Adding a look/colour is backward compatible; removing one invalidates saved avatars.
